providers.name: Meta Muse
providers.noteEN: Weekly Muse allowance; not generic model tokens. No public personal quota API verified. Manual entries only.
providers.noteZH: 每周 Muse 额度，不等同于通用模型 token；未确认公开个人额度 API。当前支持手动记录。

providers.name: Grok Bot
providers.noteEN: New X plans share a weekly pool with Cursor and Grok; legacy plans differ. No personal quota API verified. Not Grok Build.
providers.noteZH: 新 X 套餐与 Cursor、Grok 共用周额度；旧套餐口径不同。未确认个人额度 API；不是 Grok Build。

providers.name: Manus Cue
providers.noteEN: Cue phone usage has a separate weekly allowance, not Manus credits. Personal quota API coverage unverified.
providers.noteZH: Cue 电话用量使用独立周额度，不消耗 Manus credits；个人额度 API 覆盖范围未确认。

providers.name: Wabi
providers.noteEN: No public personal usage API verified. No web scraping or login-cookie reuse. Manual records do not imply a known quota.
providers.noteZH: 未确认公开个人用量 API；不抓网页或复用登录 cookie。手动记录不表示已知 Wabi 有固定额度。

providers.name: ChatGPT / Work
providers.noteEN: Plan-specific Work/Codex shared pools and regular Chat limits differ. API billing is separate. Record the exact dashboard unit and pool.
providers.noteZH: Work/Codex 依套餐共用额度，常规 Chat 限额不同；API 另行计费。请记录官方页面实际单位与共享池。

providers.name: Claude
providers.noteEN: Claude app and Claude Code share plan usage; session and weekly windows differ. API billing is separate. No personal quota adapter in this build.
providers.noteZH: Claude 与 Claude Code 共用套餐用量；会话与每周窗口不同，API 另行计费。当前未接个人额度接口。

providers.name: Gemini
providers.noteEN: Compute-based app limits and reset windows are plan-dependent. Gemini API project quotas are separate. Manual entries only.
providers.noteZH: 应用采用计算用量限制，重置依套餐；Gemini API 项目配额是另一套数据。当前支持手动记录。

providers.name: Manus
providers.noteEN: Usage/credit APIs exist, but personal API keys grant full account access and standard OAuth cannot read all usage endpoints. Not connected; Cue allowance is separate.
providers.noteZH: 有用量/积分接口，但个人 API key 拥有完整账户权限，普通 OAuth 无法读取全部用量端点。尚未接入；Cue 额度另计。

providers.name: Replit Agent
providers.noteEN: Credits can cover Agent and cloud services; dashboard may lag by 30 minutes. Separate Free Mode allowance from paid usage. Manual entries only.
providers.noteZH: 积分可覆盖 Agent 与云服务；面板可能延迟 30 分钟。免费模式额度与付费用量分开记录。当前手动。

providers.name: Lovable
providers.noteEN: Build/chat and run usage can draw from one balance. Daily grants and monthly credits differ. Do not sum shared balances. Manual entries only.
providers.noteZH: 构建/聊天与运行可共用一个余额；每日赠额和月度积分不同，不重复累加共享余额。当前手动。

providers.name: Genspark / GenCode
providers.noteEN: Weekly Free Quota and billing-cycle credits are separate; credit history can lag for hours. Some chat/image limits are separate. GenCode uses Genspark credits, not the Standard-agent free pool. No quota connector verified.
providers.noteZH: 每周 Free Quota 与账期 credits 分开，历史可延迟数小时；部分聊天/图像另有限额。GenCode 使用 Genspark credits，不使用 Standard Agent 免费池。未确认额度接口。

providers.name: Lindy
providers.noteEN: One workspace credit pool spans teammates and agents. Monthly plan credits reset with the billing cycle; purchased top-ups remain. Individual caps are not extra pools. Manual/import only.
providers.noteZH: 团队成员与 Agent 共用工作区积分池；月套餐积分按账期重置，购买的补充积分保留。个人上限不是额外池。当前手动/导入。

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.noteEN: Credits and feature-specific usage limits vary by plan and entry point. Consumer benefits belong to the subscription owner, not all Family members. No personal quota connector verified.
providers.noteZH: Credits 与功能限额依套餐和入口不同；个人订阅 AI 权益仅属于订阅所有者，不自动共享给 Family 成员。未确认个人额度接口。

providers.name: Notion Agent / Custom Agents
providers.noteEN: Standard, Select and workspace Notion credits are separate pools. Agents can draw from a workspace pool depending on admin policy; record exact workspace, unit and reset. Manual/import only.
providers.noteZH: Standard、Select 与工作区 Notion credits 分为不同池；Agent 依管理员策略使用工作区额度，记录具体工作区、单位与重置。当前手动/导入。

providers.name: Perplexity Computer / Comet
providers.noteEN: Computer has plan-dependent weekly included usage and separate credits. Comet Work mode uses Computer; Search does not. Weekly and billing-cycle resets differ. No personal quota connector verified.
providers.noteZH: Computer 的每周包含用量与 credits 分开；Comet Work 使用 Computer，Search 不消耗 credits。周重置与账期不同，未确认个人额度接口。

providers.name: Perplexity API
providers.noteEN: API Console usage is separate from consumer subscription allowances. Model tokens and tool/session fees differ. Not connected.
providers.noteZH: API Console 用量不能当成消费者订阅额度；模型 token、工具和会话费用不同。尚未接入。

providers.name: OpenHands
providers.noteEN: Uses the configured model provider; token/spend records can overlap the provider bill. Cloud and self-hosted compute are distinct. Manual/import only.
providers.noteZH: 使用所配置的模型供应商；token/费用可能与供应商账单重叠，云端与自托管计算分开。当前手动/文件导入。

providers.name: OpenRouter API key
providers.noteEN: Optional documented GET /api/v1/key connector. Shows this key’s spend/cap, NOT account balance. No management key requested; key may still authorize model calls elsewhere.
providers.noteZH: 可选官方 GET /api/v1/key 查询此 key 的费用/上限，不是账户余额。不要求管理密钥；此 key 在其他地方仍可能用于付费调用。

providers.name: OpenAI API
providers.noteEN: Organization administration endpoints need admin credentials. API usage is separate from ChatGPT/Codex plan pools. Not connected.
providers.noteZH: 组织管理接口需要管理凭据；API 用量不同于 ChatGPT/Codex 套餐额度。尚未接入。

providers.name: Claude API
providers.noteEN: Organization Usage/Cost Admin API is not available to individual accounts; platform-specific restrictions apply. Not Claude subscription usage. Not connected.
providers.noteZH: 组织 Usage/Cost Admin API 不适用于个人账户，且受平台限制；不是 Claude 订阅用量。尚未接入。

providers.name: Gemini API
providers.noteEN: RPM/TPM/RPD quotas are project-scoped, not per key. Daily RPD resets at Pacific midnight. Separate from Gemini app limits. Not connected.
providers.noteZH: RPM/TPM/RPD 按项目而非 key 计；每日 RPD 在太平洋时间午夜重置。不同于 Gemini 应用额度。尚未接入。

providers.name: xAI API
providers.noteEN: Developer API billing is not Grok app or Grok Bot subscription allowance. Management access requires separate review; not connected.
providers.noteZH: 开发者 API 账单不是 Grok 应用或 Grok Bot 订阅额度。管理权限需另行评估，尚未接入。
